items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: and David (unintelligible). Three of the best announcers in the business, in the world.

ctx.x: When we stopped playing that for our theme song, that thing broke my heart. That was the prettiest thing and we used to play it. We broadcast -- we used to broadcast from the Cotton Club from 6:00 to 7:00, every night. We had three of the best announcers. We had Ted Husing, Dick Brokenshire

and David (unintelligible). Three of the best announcers in the business, in the world. They would come up to the Cotton Club especially Ted Husing, he's still living. Like you make out a program, you know, different numbers you want to play. He wouldn't let us. He would say you play this, and he would pick out some of our finest. That's right.
Did you read much when you were in the band?
